note: USACE Rock Island District campground on the Mississippi River backwaters near Hanover, 13 mi south of Galena: grass sites under hardwoods, boat ramp, fishing and birding. Sites 01 and 02 at the west end look through a line of trees across marsh to the river, about 110 m off; the electric loop sits back in the woods. A railroad runs along the campground's east edge. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility, rates, per-site catalog, site photos and imagery read. 37 sites (7 non-electric 25-30 ft, 30 electric at 50 A to 40 ft); 2027 $14/$24 (unchanged since 2019); reservation-only on rec.gov (walk-ups book on site); showers, flush/vault toilets, seasonal water, dump. Riverview kept on 01/02 (filtered view in the official site photos); not riverfront. Pin fine (~180 m).
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview confirmed, not riverfront. 01 (42.285544,-90.402988) and 02 (42.285411,-90.403016), non-electric 30-ft sites sold nightly on rec.gov: their 2021 rec.gov photos look west through a line of leafless trees to wide water; imagery puts the open channel ~110 m away across a tree belt and marsh (the boat-ramp inlet, ~20 m wide, is ~55 m from 01 behind trees). 04/05 photos show no water. Electric sites 08-37 are 150-250 m from water in forest.

SITES: catalog 37 campsites (stored 38 counted the group picnic shelter). Site 15 is 15 ft with no RV/trailer permitted; 25-ft pads at 05-07; every other site 30-40 ft. Stored max_rig 50 (note prose) -> 40 (catalog).
BOOKING: reservation only, including walk-ups (book on rec.gov at the site) -> fcfs never. minConsecutiveStay 1 soft = no rule. rec.gov 'militaryDiscount' rule flag not written.
